facts: Official image API uses set_image then predict with prompts.
Current requirements: Python>=3.10, torch>=2.5.1, torchvision>=0.20.1; lower-torch installation may upgrade torch.
Repository recommends a new environment and documents optional custom CUDA extension limitations.
set_image accepts RGB HWC arrays with values 0..255.
predict accepts XY pixel points, foreground/background point labels 1/0, and an XYXY box; masks return at original image dimensions.
Multimask output and predicted mask quality are supported.
Inputs are an image and text; outputs are boxes with word similarities, filtered using box/text thresholds.
Category names can be separated with periods; CPU-only inference is documented.
Installation requires model code/dependencies/config/checkpoint; CUDA extension setup is documented.
Official helper preprocesses captions and returns boxes/logits/phrases.
Postprocessing scales normalized center-size boxes by original width/height and converts them to XYXY.

candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.input: SAM2 image + initializer q8 bounding box
candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.definition: For a future frozen source-only adapter, a finite nondegenerate original q8 can supply [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y] in original image pixel coordinates, with an explicitly frozen clipping/invalid policy. This is a derived prompt only; original q8, each selected q and L remain byte-preserved. No GT box replacement.
candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.limitation: A geometric envelope can include foreign objects, background, multiple pallets or invisible projected corners; it is not a certified pallet foreground box. Missing/degenerate prompts must remain explicit unavailable cases, without guessed replacements.

candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.input: SAM2 image + remaining genuinely visible points
candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.definition: Official XY point prompts require foreground/background labels. A future adapter may use only separately justified source-input foreground witnesses whose acquisition is declared before inference. Original initializer points alone do not certify visibility or foreground ownership.
candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.limitation: Do not treat all available q8 as foreground, select points using new held labels/scores, or use native/pose/GT labels as an undeclared prompt. Adding a source-training manually certified point would be a distinct human-assisted prompt condition, not the unchanged initializer-only baseline.

candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.definition: The documented text API can propose semantic boxes for pallet; an explicitly frozen coordinate conversion can supply those XYXY boxes to SAM2. Neither text nor original q/L needs alteration.
candidate_input_contracts_not_selected_a.limitation: Text detection identifies category candidates, not the original selected instance. No proposal/mask choice using held/private outcomes; retain every no-detection/multiple-instance ambiguity under a prospective fixed policy. Official example thresholds are examples, not a calibrated physical visibility probability or a newly chosen threshold here.

target_definition_separation.class_agnostic_mask: SAM2 image prompt API returns masks and mask-quality estimates, not a pallet class/native-slot identity field. Treat semantic or selected-instance ownership as a separate unverified assignment.
target_definition_separation.semantic_pallet: GroundingDINO text supplies semantic candidate boxes. Semantic pallet match does not certify which stacked/adjacent pallet is the initializer target.
target_definition_separation.literal_query_owner: Mask membership at the unchanged q may be a predicted ownership witness, conditional on correct target-instance assignment. It is not an ownership ground truth.
target_definition_separation.crop_presence: A target-like region somewhere in local96 is a crop-presence proposition. It does not establish that the literal center belongs to the target.
target_definition_separation.native_part_visibility: Local query crop mask, center ownership, whole-pallet mask and original registered 3D/native-part external visibility are different propositions. None may silently replace the original native D/E/S task.
target_definition_separation.amodal_limit: Reviewer inference from documented outputs: these APIs provide no certificate that a specific hidden native part exists behind an occluder, nor its physical correspondence/coordinate accuracy. Mask completion must not be called certified amodal presence or native visibility.
target_definition_separation.coordinate_contract: Retain original q8/q/L/native IDs and input availability. If a crop is used later, separately verify its known original-to-crop prompt transform; never move q to a predicted mask, correct xy, or invoke PnP.

Keep all failures and unchanged original q8/q/L/availability.

After a separate root entry, perform only a small deterministic frozen SOURCE_TRAIN smoke test: input/hash/coordinate parity, output dimensions, repeated inference equality and explicit no-prompt/no-detection/ambiguous-instance rows. This review neither installs nor runs that test.

Assess target-instance assignment, literal q membership and local crop presence as separate diagnostics against whatever certified public TRAIN mask/instance authority is actually available; preserve weak/unknown labels and native task. Native-part/occlusion/correspondence claims still require separate certified source witnesses. No held/private result may choose an arm, threshold, prompt or model.
conclusion_ko: 공식 API상 원 q8 박스·검증된 전경점·pallet 텍스트를 입력하는 source-only baseline 구조는 가능하지만 현재 환경은 실행 준비가 되지 않았습니다. 분할 마스크는 선택 팔레트 identity, 원 q 중심 소속, crop 내 존재, 3D native 부위 가시성·가림 뒤 존재를 자동으로 같은 정답으로 만들어 주지 않습니다. 새 성능·모델 채택 근거는 이번 조사에 없습니다.
